topic: Database delete failure on missing columns
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on a technical issue where the DELETE operation fails in ClickHouse when data parts are missing a column that was added later. This failure occurs because adding a field to a table does not materialize it in existing parts, causing DELETE to fail when processing those parts.

It was noted that the retry mechanism might be unnecessary, as the delete function is expected to run correctly during nightly recalculations (recalc-ch).
decisions: The team agreed that the retry logic for the operation may be redundant.
A follow-up check on the functionality of the retry mechanism should occur in about a month.
action_items: Monitor the nightly recalculation process to ensure stability regarding missing columns during DELETE operations.
